newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHELSEA SIGN NORWAY GOALKEEPER GRODAS ON LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHELSEA SIGN NORWAY GOALKEEPER GRODAS ON LOAN.

text.p: English premier league club Chelsea on Thursday signed Norwegian international goalkeeper Frode Grodas on loan from Lillestroem until the end of the year.

Chelsea boss Ruud Gullit needed to bring in cover because first-choice goalkeeper Dmitri Kharine is sidelined by a knee injury. He fell awkwardly during the 2-0 league win at Sheffield Wednesday earlier this month.
Kevin Hitchcock has taken Kharine's place.
